how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://pau.edu.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-10-2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://pau.edu. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), located in Ludhiana, Punjab, for filling up a research-based contract position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Field/Lab Helper under advertisement number E.A./2026/2960-3059, offering a fixed monthly salary plus additional allowances as specified.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Field/Lab Helper post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Field/Lab Helper position on a contract basis under Punjab Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Middle pass including the Punjabi subject, with preference given to those having extensive daily wage experience at PAU.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants applying for PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper?
faq.answer: The eligible age limit for candidates applying to this recruitment ranges from 18 years to 63 years as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper post?
faq.answer: All candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 100/- in the form of a Bank Draft made in favour of Comptroller, Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the filled application form along with the fee to Room No. 112 of the Department of Crop Science is 13-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the scheduled date for appearing before the selection committee?
faq.answer: Candidates who submit their applications are required to appear before the selection committee along with their original certificates on 23-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed proforma to the designated department before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Punjab Agricultural University website at https://pau.edu or check the important links section within this article for direct references.
